facts.fact: A police cybercrime officer says the Agence nationale de sécurité des systèmes d'information (ANSSI) carried the 2024 law on information systems security (loi 014-2024/ALT of 9 July 2024) and that the law obliges structures to be accompanied by ANSSI for audits, security protocols and measures; as_of is the document's published date, 2026-09-14, as no event date is given for the body's operation.
